name: hcportal_searchHashersForMerge
description: Merge accounts search (E12.F6.S3): live accounts (Removed = 0) whose trimmed hash name, first name, last name or 'First Last' equals a term (case-insensitive by collation), or whose email / hasher id / PublicHasherId is a term. At most 20 terms (each cut to 250 characters) and 200 rows, ordered by hash name then most recent app use. Each row carries what tells two records of one person apart. Auth: HC6.ValidatePortalAuth; caller must hold a live HC.PlatformAdmin row with CanEditKennel = 1. Since 2026-10-13 a hash name also matches when it STARTS WITH a term (wildcards in the term are literal), so an old account renamed '<name> - DO NOT USE' is found by its name.

parameters.name: searchTerms
parameters.description: '|'-delimited hash names / first or last names / 'First Last' / emails / ids (the portal converts the admin's commas). NULL or only blanks returns a refusal.

rowsets.name: Refusal
rowsets.description: { Success = 0, ErrorMessage } on auth failure, missing CanEditKennel, or no usable term. No other rowset follows.

rowsets.name: Accounts
rowsets.description: On success: one row per matching account (no envelope), at most 200. A runtime error is logged to HC.ErrorLog and re-thrown.

columns.name: SignedInDevices
columns.description: Devices with SignedOutAt NULL and removed = 0

columns.name: KennelsFollowedList
columns.description: Up to 8 followed kennels' short names, alphabetical, ', '-joined

columns.name: RecentRuns
columns.description: Last three attended runs: 'KENNEL yyyy-mm-dd (City or venue)' joined by ' · '

columns.name: IsPlatformAdmin
columns.description: 1 when the account has a live HC.PlatformAdmin row

sideEffects: On a runtime error: INSERT HC.ErrorLog, then THROW

codeSmells.detail: Lines 74-82 compare TRIM(HashName), TRIM(FirstName), TRIM(LastName) and a concatenated full name for each term, which forces a scan of every live hasher per term; acceptable for an admin tool capped at 20 terms, but it will grow with the table.

breakingChangeRules: Never remove a column from any rowset
Never change a sentinel value meaning
Never change errorType integer codes without updating all callers
